exposure: rate of lupus low disease activity state (LLDAS) attainment
cohort: The participants were 60 pregnancies in patients with systemic lupus erythematosus (SLE).
finding: C3 levels and anti-dsDNA antibody titers at conception were significantly associated with preterm birth, and C3 and CH50 levels were associated with low birth weight in patients with systemic lupus erythematosus.
